name: Of Evil and Darkness
source:
A group of paranormal investigators with their own television show head to a remote island to film an episode. Once there they encounter the evil that was let loose upon the island, long ago.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236100/]Steam[/url]]
